parsed.notes:
“What You’ll Need to Succeed” is required; “It’s Great if you have:” is optional. Company/platform descriptions and responsibilities alone do not supply criteria.
The experience fields are alternatives, but MLOps is also independently requested in the optional qualifications. Applying the standalone-mention rule literally removes it from that group; Data engineering is unmapped, leaving no two mapped members to group.
The programming-language examples and ML-framework examples each satisfy a single ask and are grouped. The Big Data tools list is read literally as an unmarked list, not an explicit alternative set.
LGBM is interpreted as LightGBM. ML frameworks maps to Machine Learning; ML project lifecycle has no exact taxonomy entry.
Kubernetes core objects and debugging describe the requested Kubernetes proficiency rather than separate taxonomy skills. Code simplicity and performance are expressed as values, not distinct technical practices.
